newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Syarikat Binaan lists at 9.0 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Syarikat Binaan lists at 9.0 rgt.

text.p: Timber concern Syarikat Binaan Budi Sawmill Bhd listed on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's Second Board on Monday at 9.00 ringgit, compared with a 3.10 ringgit offer price.
At 0133 GMT, the stock was trading at 9.05 ringgit after reaching a high of 9.10.

The maker of timber products had offered three million shares in its public issue and conducted an offer for sale of an additional 2.7 million shares. All the shares were offered at 3.10 ringgit apiece.
For the financial year ended December 31, 1996, the company reported turnover of 50.86 million ringgit, and net profit of 7.37 million ringgit or 24.55 cents a share.
It has forecast net profit of 9.13 million ringgit or 38.69 cents a share for the year ending December 31, 1997.

The public issue, after deducting expenses and fees, is expected to raise 8.1 million ringgit for the company. Syarikat Budi is using part of the proceeds for purchase of plant and machinery, and for repayment of bank borrowings.
